notes: The posted results in doc_registry_NCT03574597.json were searched in outcomeMeasuresModule (measure titles and descriptions) and adverseEventsModule (event terms and all-cause, serious, and other event totals). They do not report adverse events leading to permanent discontinuation of the trial product. The held doc_ctgov_results_NCT03574597.json outcome measures likewise do not contain this outcome. Counts and arm ownership therefore come from the abstract in doc_records_pmid_37952131.txt; denominators are the explicitly printed numbers assigned to each arm in its RESULTS sentence. All four printed counts agree with row.json.served.
